content: {"episode_id":"ep-05163","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration is requested for cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271), denied under PR-204 as not covered under the member’s current benefit plan. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease. The note indicates cardiac event monitoring to further characterize the frequency and burden of these arrhythmic events and guide ongoing management."}
